business_summary: WIZ CORP, Inc. engages in highway rest areas and gas stations, food and beverage sales, vehicle LPG refueling, and building rental and related services in Korea. The company also operates business centers that provide independent office space, conference rooms, relaxation zones, seminar rooms, and common area, as well as highway rest areas and gas stations. In addition, it is involved in the industrial materials business, which includes starch for papermaking, and industrial starch used in architecture, cosmetics, gunpowder, mining, paper, adhesive, pharmaceuticals, and fiber products; and food material business, such as sugar and premix, as well as offering venture incubating services. Further, it provides systematic educational services by combining offline academies with online learning content and maintains a stable business foundation through the operation of a suitable curriculum and personalized learning management. Additionally, the company provides engages in investment and loans for startups and SMEs, investment in domestic and foreign securities, provision of management diagnostic and consulting services, management and operation of rest areas and food service businesses, general distribution businesses, hospitality services, software development, sales and leasing, system integration services, e-commerce, publishing, book wholesale and retail, online content provision, and lifelong education facility operations. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 위즈주식회사(WIZ CORP, Inc.)는 한국에서 고속도로 휴게소 및 주유소, 식음료 판매, 차량용 LPG 충전, 건물 임대 및 관련 서비스를 영위하고 있습니다. 또한, 독립된 사무공간, 회의실, 휴식공간, 세미나실, 공용공간을 제공하는 비즈니스센터와 고속도로 휴게소, 주유소 등을 운영하고 있습니다. 또한, 제지용 전분과 건축, 화장품, 화약, 광업, 제지, 접착제, 의약품, 섬유제품 등에 사용되는 공업용 전분 등 산업자재 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 설탕, 프리믹스 등 식자재 사업과 벤처 인큐베이팅 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 또한, 오프라인 아카데미와 온라인 학습 콘텐츠를 결합하여 체계적인 교육 서비스를 제공하고, 적합한 커리큘럼 운영과 개인별 학습 관리를 통해 안정적인 사업 기반을 유지하고 있습니다. 또한, 스타트업 및 중소기업에 대한 투자 및 대출, 국내외 증권 투자, 경영진단 및 컨설팅 서비스 제공, 휴게소 및 외식업 관리 및 운영 업무를 수행하고 있습니다.
